# Best Sabah

> A local guide to Kota Kinabalu and Sabah, Malaysia. Written by a Sabahan who was born here and never had a reason to leave. No sponsored content, no press trips. Just honest recommendations from someone who actually lives here.

## About
- [About Best Sabah](https://bestsabah.com/about.html): About the author — a lifelong Sabahan writing about food, places, and real life in KK.

## Posts

### Things To Do
- [Climbing Mount Kinabalu Guide](https://bestsabah.com/posts/climbing-mount-kinabalu-guide.html): Complete first-timer's guide to climbing Mount Kinabalu — booking via sabapakeco.com, RM1,150+ per person for the 2D1N package (permit, guide, Laban Rata accommodation, meals, park entry), training tips, Kampung Adidas shoes, Day 1 trail to Laban Rata (3,270m), 2AM summit push to Low's Peak (4,095m). Best months: February–April.
- [Best Shopping Mall in Kota Kinabalu: Imago](https://bestsabah.com/posts/best-shopping-mall-kota-kinabalu-imago.html): Imago at KK Times Square — best mall in KK since 2015, Uniqlo, Victoria's Secret, Michael Kors, Coach, GSC cinema, food street, Jollibee, Everrise supermarket. 10am–10pm daily. Off Coastal Highway.

### Best Food
- [Best Bak Kut Teh in Kota Kinabalu: Yu Kee](https://bestsabah.com/posts/best-bak-kut-teh-kota-kinabalu.html): Yu Kee at 74 Jalan Gaya — herbal pork broth, fall-off-the-bone meat, free soup refill, self-service condiments. RM20–40 per person. Open daily 2:15pm–10pm.
- [Best Beef Noodles in KK: Yii Siang](https://bestsabah.com/posts/yii-siang-beef-noodle-kk.html): Yii Siang Hainan Ngiu Chap Sdn Bhd in Nountun Industrial Estate, Inanam — RM14 medium ngiu chap, RM16 laksa version. Clear beef soup, multiple cuts, Hainanese style. Mon–Sat 6:30am–3pm, Sun 6:30am–2pm. Free parking.

### Sports
- [Best Badminton Shop in KK: AST Sports Centre](https://bestsabah.com/posts/best-badminton-shop-kota-kinabalu-ast-sports-centre.html): AST Sports Centre at Foochow Association Building, Kota Kinabalu — cheapest prices, 5 stringing machines, all major brands (Yonex, Victor, Li-Ning), badminton training for kids. Opens 10am daily. Phone: 016-833 9951.
